_readme: Synthetic demo tenant v2 — the Wolds Link, a fictional ~32 km A-road dualling scheme in the East Midlands. Nothing in it is anyone's data. Import into an EMPTY tenant (POST /api/admin/tenant/import; replace=1 over the v1 demo), then bake the network (HERE) for EVERY planning vehicle the lines use (Artic Tipper, Artic Flatbed, Rigid 8-wheeler, and since 14 Oct 2026 the two concrete mixers on the batching plant's routes) — routes read UNBAKED until then, and the works-zone geofence only re-routes what is baked. Diesel index: fetched automatically from DESNZ weekly road fuel prices (H1); fuel_index below is a typed placeholder applied on import if the GB row is empty. Distances read in miles (tenant.distance_unit); km is what is stored. tenant.demo_notice puts 'DEMO · Fictional scheme' on every screen and export. Carbon planner (10 Oct 2026): Langton Compound's surplus cut goes to a fictional inert landfill (four approved months); a fictional soil-recycling hub nearer by has a route and no forecast — the disposal alternative. The two electric lorry profiles are scenario-only: they read the diesel twin's baked distances and are never offered on a forecast.
